verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs say its headless 'Local LLM Service' exposes embedding, alongside completions and chat completions, as a local server powering your app. It also serves models on OpenAI-like endpoints and offers a REST API for your own apps, so embeddings can be served to retrieval and search applications. Missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation of the embeddings API, a list of supported embedding models, and independent or hands-on corroboration of embedding serving for retrieval workloads.
